chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Among the blessings of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, upon a man is that his child resembles him.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man upon whom this blessing is bestowed
key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One who bestows the blessing
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic, an expression of divine exaltation
key_terms.نِعَمِ: blessings or favors granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: What blessing does this hadith mention regarding a man and his child?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies a child resembling his father as one of Allah’s blessings upon a man. It highlights familial resemblance as a favor from Allah, reflecting joy, recognition, and a bond within the family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Among the blessings of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, upon a man is that his child resembles him."
